definitions.valid_transactions: Distinct orders with an ID, a parsed MM/DD/YYYY date, a true source-validity flag, positive sales, and INR currency.
definitions.repeat_rate: Customers with at least two valid transactions in the filtered scope divided by active customers in that scope.
definitions.cohort_retention: Customers active at cohort age m divided by customers first observed in that acquisition month within the filtered scope.
definitions.average_transaction_value: Gross valid INR sales divided by valid transactions; not labelled AOV because the source grain is unverified.
